name: Gru's Plan
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid of Gru from Despicable Me presenting at a flip chart with a blank pale blue sheet. He beams and raises a finger, then grins slyly, then leans in expectantly, and in the last panel turns back to the chart in confused alarm.
use: Each flip chart sheet shows one step of a plan. The first two steps sound fine, the third reveals an obvious flaw, and the fourth repeats that flaw as Gru realizes what it means.
slots: the step with the flaw (third chart, bottom left)
the same flaw again (fourth chart, bottom right)
examples: Stay up all night to finish the project
describe: despicable me villain presenting a plan on a flip chart
bald cartoon guy with a presentation board who realizes his plan is flawed
four panel animated villain explaining steps then looking confused
cartoon man pointing at an easel then doing a double take
minions movie guy giving a presentation that goes wrong
origin: Stills of Gru presenting his plan in the 2010 animated film Despicable Me.
